$comment: Pulse /split split_config for the joint-interest month (SYNTHETIC corpus). Topic names match the month record's split keys. Two field tickets ride in the day12 packet, so the ticket class is split into two ordered topics; see pipeline.run_synth for the mapping and the one-ticket fallback.

split_input.name: afe_cover
split_input.description: Operator cover letter pages transmitting an AFE to a working-interest owner for election.

split_input.name: afe
split_input.description: Authorization for Expenditure pages: AFE header block and the account-coded cost estimate table.

split_input.name: field_ticket_1
split_input.description: Pages of the FIRST vendor field ticket in this packet, in page order. A field ticket has a ticket number, a service date, and a small table of charge rows with quantity, unit, rate, and amount.

split_input.name: field_ticket_2
split_input.description: Pages of the SECOND vendor field ticket in this packet, in page order. Use this topic only for a ticket whose ticket number differs from the first ticket's; leave it empty when the packet holds only one ticket.

split_input.name: hauling_log
split_input.description: Fluid hauling or vacuum truck log pages: numbered loads with time, fluid type, barrels, and destination.

split_input.name: invoice
split_input.description: Vendor invoice pages: invoice number, ticket-referenced rows, subtotal, tax, total.

split_input.name: jib_statement
split_input.description: Joint Interest Billing statement pages: owner header block and billing lines with gross amount, owner decimal, and net amount.

split_input.name: other
split_input.description: Anything else, including blank, illegible, or transmittal pages.
